verdict.rationale: Bento runs several user-configured processes autonomously in the background. Plain-English signals fire in real time and backfill history (bentolabs-docs-4). English-written alert rules route to Slack, PagerDuty, email or webhook, and incidents are auto-judged real or benign (bentolabs-docs-7, bentolabs-docs-8). Trigger-based fixes run in shadow mode and graduate to full traffic on their own (bentolabs-docs-11, bentolabs-docs-12). These automations are confined to monitoring and remediation of agent traces rather than general-purpose user automations, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: general-purpose automation/workflow builder beyond monitoring, scheduling/trigger configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
